items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: When I left them I joined Bob Lyons band.

ctx.x: Celestan used to send us on jobs and things. Called the original Tuxedo and the Young Tuxedo. That's what the name was. I played with them. So it was wild. When I left them I joined Bob Lyons band. When I took Willie Edwards place.
You got his in the Bob Lyons band.
Yeah. Didn't get all the members of the Bob Lyons band. You have the trumpet and who was clarinet? Sidney Bean. That's right. Sidney Bean.
